source: NASA FIRMS, MODIS Collection 6.1 active fire detections, 2024 country yearly summary (modis_2024_all_countries.zip)
method: Type-0 (presumed vegetation fire) detections of 2024 grouped by 1-degree cell (south-west corner) and the day/night flag. Each count is stored as a level ceil(log2(count + 1)) capped at 9. Cells with fewer than 3 detections are left out. For drawing only; the game's counts per orbit are in firms-coverage-2024.json.
